answer: Verified captain's license attestation stops fake identities: each account must hold a license in its legal name, confirmed with the maritime authority. When a new identity applies, the authority checks its license number and sea-time hours, and any duplicate or forged license is rejected before the account is created. One license costs $2,500 in course, exam and medical fees, so an honest user pays $2,500 once while 1,000 fakes cost $2,500,000. The jetty where captains dock, the whisper of the harbor master's clearance, and the echo of the logbook keep the system clean.
